answer: I would wager my own seat on Blackwork stitcher heraldic banner proof embroidered onto the embroiderers hall, because its proof, each heraldic banner is a measured thread yield plus an embroiderer signature, is public and checkable. The nebula is the gate, the trellis the key, the grove the gate's memory — and the gate remembers every passage the farm would rather forget. A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof before lunch. The inspection fee is 64 POA per proof, kept either way, so 440 proofs cost the farm 28160 POA with nothing to show for a rejection.
